title: Concept: Maven mirror takes over every repository
description: settings.xml declares a mirror with `mirrorOf` set to `*`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: All declared repositories, including reviewed internal ones, resolve through one mirror, so its publication controls become the only control.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.xml (maven).
risk: All declared repositories, including reviewed internal ones, resolve through one mirror, so its publication controls become the only control.
